question: Do three ancestry-labelled height summary-statistic files constitute an external genotype-to-phenotype test, or only a source manifest?

gwas_catalog_v2.name: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog REST API v2

accession_requirements.interaction_study_excluded: gxe and gxg are not true, and the disease-trait label contains neither an interaction marker nor an interaction term

metrics: incremental explained variance over an additive polygenic-score denominator
required_holdout_fields: held-out genotype or frozen polygenic score
measured height on a declared scale
relatedness or household grouping for resampling

readiness_decision.ready_if: Every frozen accession passes the file manifest and a cohort-disjoint individual-level holdout supplies every required final-metric field under an approved data-use path.

leakage_contract.no_random_row_split: No random row split may cross participant, family, household, or cohort boundaries.
leakage_contract.cohort_disjointness: Distinct accession IDs or ancestry labels do not prove participant-level or cohort-level disjointness; cohort lineage must be explicit.
leakage_contract.publication_exposure: A public study already analyzed within the same paper or used for locus selection is a retrospective sentinel, not an unopened confirmation holdout.
leakage_contract.ancestry_semantics: Catalog ancestry labels are metadata descriptors, not interchangeable biological categories or causal variables.
leakage_contract.feature_selection: No held-out cohort association, publication result, or phenotype transformation may guide variant filtering, weighting, calibration, or hyperparameter choice.
leakage_contract.scale_alignment: Raw height, residualized height, and inverse-normalized height are not treated as one response scale without a frozen transformation contract.

files: complete one-page exact-trait GWAS Catalog v2 query
one GWAS Catalog v2 record per frozen accession
root and harmonised FTP directory listings per accession
raw and harmonised metadata YAML per accession
HTTP metadata for each large summary-statistics artifact
PubMed summary for each distinct publication
frozen_source_retention.large_data_policy: Do not duplicate multi-gigabyte summary-statistics files in this repository; retain declared checksums, HTTP headers, metadata, filenames, and source URLs.
frozen_source_retention.compression: gzip with mtime=0 for deterministic bytes
frozen_source_retention.hash: SHA-256 over every retained small source file

inspected_during_protocol_design: their public FTP directory listings and metadata YAML
pilot_disclosure.boundary: Pilot inspection established current accessions, schemas, cohorts, ancestry labels, licenses, file formats, and the missing G&H gxe flag. The frozen rule does not reinterpret a missing flag as false: it excludes records only when an interaction flag is true or the disease-trait label itself denotes an interaction. No candidate prediction, calibration slope, explained variance, or bootstrap result was computed.

controls.positive: A synthetic three-accession roster with distinct cohorts and ancestries, complete GWAS-SSF metadata, and all individual-level holdout fields must be evaluation-ready.
controls.negative: Three harmonised summary-statistic files without participant-level outcomes and cluster keys must remain blocked.

next_gate_if_ready: Freeze variant intersection, allele alignment, LD reference, phenotype transformation, participant/family/cohort split, additive denominator, covariates, bootstrap clusters, and calibration code before opening any held-out outcomes.
interpretation_boundaries: This packet audits public accessions, ancestry/cohort metadata, file interoperability, and leakage risk only.
It does not estimate an individual's height, ancestry, disease risk, or clinical outcome.
It does not establish causal genotype-to-phenotype mapping or portability of a polygenic score.
No re-identification, reproductive selection, clinical decision, wet-lab, or solved-frontier claim is permitted.
